title: Stronger regression checks; physics optimization withdrawn
changes: Full-state testing caught an ice trajectory difference at 1.45 s. The trial optimization was withdrawn; original contact evaluation and energy gates are retained.
Analytical coverage expands to 4,224 cases. The comparison tool can isolate a material pair and preserve both actual replies in a failure witness.
Viewport and projection work now run on resize. Whole-rig framing fits the actual declared geometry, including the ball at 10 m.
No calculation speed improvement is published. Energy/contact accuracy, realtime speed, metal dents, adaptive cells and authoring remain open.
